! check update crop development
      fl_continue = .TRUE.
      if (sw_wofost == 3) then
         m%tdelay = max(0, m%tdelay - 1)
         if (.NOT. fl_tsum .OR. m%tdelay > 0) fl_continue = .FALSE.
      end if
      
      ! update crop development
      if (fl_continue) then
      
         ! - daily dry matter production -
      
         r%gass = r%pgass * reltr

         ! respiration and partitioning of carbohydrates between growth and maintenance respiration
         rmres = (p%rmr*s%wrt + p%rml*s%wlv + p%rms*s%wst + p%rmo*s%wso) * afgen (p%rfsetb, macroptb, dvs)

         teff = p%q10**((tav - 25.d0) / 10.d0)
         r%mres = min(r%gass, rmres * teff)
         asrc = r%gass - r%mres

wlvpot = s%wlv
         wsopot = s%wso
         
         grrtpot = r%grrt ! rate; not for output
         
         ipgasspot= ipgasspot+ r%pgass
         igasspot = igasspot + r%gass
         imrespot = imrespot + r%mres

      ! actual crop status
      else

         lai = s%lai
         
         grrt = r%grrt ! rate; not for output
         
         drrt = r%drrt ! rate; not for output
         drst = r%drst ! rate; not for output
         drlv = r%drlv ! rate; not for output
         
         dwrt = s%dwrt
         dwst = s%dwst
         dwlv = s%dwlv
         
         wrt = s%wrt
         wst = s%wst
         wlv = s%wlv
         wso = s%wso
                  
         ipgass= ipgass+ r%pgass
         igass = igass + r%gass
         imres = imres + r%mres

      end if

! daily gross assimilation
      effc = fco2eff * p%eff
      amax = fco2amax * afgen (p%amaxtb, macroptb, dvs) * afgen (p%tmpftb, macroptb, tavd)

      ! potential assimilation
      call totass (dayl, amax, effc, s_pot%lai, difpp, dsinbe, sinld, cosld, dtgapot)

      ! correction for low minimum temperature
      dtgapot = dtgapot * afgen (p%tmnftb, macroptb, tmnr)

      ! potential assimilation in kg ch2o per ha, corrected for carbon fraction
      r_pot%pgass = dtgapot * 30.d0 * (0.4d0 / p%cfrdm) / 44.d0
      if (p%sw_potrelmf == 2) r_pot%pgass = r_pot%pgass * p%relmf

      ! actual assimilation
      call totass (dayl, amax, effc, s_act%lai, difpp, dsinbe, sinld, cosld, dtga)

      ! correction for low minimum temperature
      dtga = dtga * afgen (p%tmnftb, macroptb, tmnr)
      
      ! actual assimilation in kg ch2o per ha, corrected for carbon fraction
      r_act%pgass = dtga * 30.d0 * (0.4d0 / p%cfrdm)/ 44.d0
      r_act%pgass = r_act%pgass * p%relmf

if (name == 'PWDM')         value = wsopot + wstpot + dwstpot + wlvpot + dwlvpot
         if (name == 'WDM')          value = wso + wst + dwst + wlv + dwlv


         if (name == 'PGASSTPOT')    value = ipgasspot
         if (name == 'PGASST')       value = ipgass
         if (name == 'GASSTPOT')     value = igasspot
         if (name == 'GASST')        value = igass
         if (name == 'MRESTPOT')     value = imrespot
         if (name == 'MREST')        value = imres

end if
         if (swsnow == 1) then
            igsnow = 0.0d0
            isubl  = 0.0d0
            isnrai = 0.0d0
         end if
         
         ipgass= 0.d0; ipgasspot= 0.d0
         igass = 0.d0; igasspot = 0.d0
         imres = 0.d0; imrespot = 0.d0
         
         ivolbeg   = volact
         ipondbeg  = pond
         issnowbeg = ssnow

parameter_lines: CFRDM = 0.45               ! Carbon fraction in dry matter (default = 0.4) [0..1 kg C/kg MD, R]
RELMF = 0.7                ! Relative management factor to reduce theoretical potential yield to attainable yield [0..1 -, R]
CFRDM = 0.4                ! Carbon fraction in dry matter (default = 0.4) [0..1 kg C/kg MD, R]
RELMF = 1.0                ! Relative management factor to reduce theoretical potential yield to attainable yield [0..1 -, R]
